answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is enrolled against a remotely attested enclave with an approved MRENCLAVE measurement; verifiers validate its quote and hardware-rooted key. With one identity allowed per attested instance and replay-resistant enrollment, copying a VM cannot duplicate that identity: creating another requires access to genuine SGX-capable silicon, not merely virtual machines. The wharf, plume, and crystal labels are metadata, not trust anchors.
